about: Dialysis machine modelled as a generic product: castors with brakes, base, lower body, jug shelf with acid concentrate jug and bicarbonate cartridge, upper body with two blood pump housings and rotors, heparin syringe pump, pressure ports, tilting monitor, status light, dialyser on arm with arterial and venous caps, IV pole. Water and gases via the nested service point (FMC_P_MechEq_ServicePoint); Medical Equipment cannot hold pipe connectors. Reference: query: machine dialysis medical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=machine+dialysis+medical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
